cases.name: switch-without-on
cases.description: A switch with no subject to look up

cases.name: switch-unknown-subject
cases.description: A switch on a sequence that does not exist

cases.name: switch-with-no-entries
cases.description: A switch with nothing to match against
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="G"><gen type="text" value="a,b"/></sequence><switch name="S" on="G"></switch></env><block><line><data>x</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: case-without-is
cases.description: A switch case with no key
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="G"><gen type="text" value="a,b"/></sequence><switch name="S" on="G"><case><data>x</data></case></switch></env><block><line><data>x</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-name-on-a-nested-switch
cases.description: A <switch> inside a <case> contributes its value to that branch; it is not a column, so nothing can interpolate it and a name would name nothing. Refused rather than ignored — an ignored name reads as a declaration, and a later ${{Inner}} would then fail somewhere else entirely.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="R"><gen type="text" value="a,b"/></sequence><switch name="Outer" on="R"><case is="a"><switch name="Inner" on="R"><case is="a"><data>x</data></case></switch></case><default><data>y</data></default></switch></env><block><line><data>${{Outer}}</data></line></block></tdc>
